items.title: Bill Bourgeois Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: Jewfree, I must have gone to him about two years.

ctx.x: Now back when you were starting you say you studied more or less by yourself for say three years or something like that? Oh yeah, quite a while, yeah. And then Jewfree, how long were you under him?
Jewfree, I must have gone to him about two years. Any other teachers?

items.title: Bill Bourgeois Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: Fazola used to come in and sit in... I said, play for two hours and I'll buy you a sandwich and a drink... So I used to stand next to him and hum, and he'd play just what I hum.

ctx.x: Skagg Leone, yeah. And what about him? We were talking about him and Fass, huh?
He was a very, very fine musician. And I think Fazzola was one of his... He was Fazzola's idol.
Yeah, I see. Sort of took after him. Yeah. And while we were talking, you mentioned Hank Kamen, one of the teachers here. You used to know him.
